What ''about'' them?|Xandel Carivus and the Imperial officer, during the Battle of Ord Cantrell|<ref name="Crimson Empire II 6">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 6|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 6]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' who served the [[Crimson Empire]] in its final [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. As the last [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet]], he led the Crimson Empire [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|defense]] of [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] as both an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. When [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Xandel Carivus]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle, the Crimson Empire ceased to exist.

==Biography==
===Taking command===
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a mustache served as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> during the [[Crimson Empire]]. Having emerged from the ruins of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Empire]], the Crimson Empire held the only [[Imperial Space|territory]] still answerable to centralized Imperial control.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> The [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]] led the Crimson Empire from a [[Council Tower|villa]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell's]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[De-Purteen]],<ref name="Crimson Empire II 1">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 1|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 1]]</ref> where the mustachioed [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was also stationed.<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> 11 ABY saw several council members [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by [[Nom Anor]]&mdash;an advance [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invading]] [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was trying to hasten the Crimson Empire's collapse<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|under "Nom Anor"}}</ref>&mdash;and by members of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Handbook Black Sun">[[Star Wars Handbook 2: Crimson Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 2: ''Crimson Empire'']] {{C|under "Black Sun"}}</ref> Following the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Llon Banjeer]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Immodet]],<ref name="Handbook Council">[[Star Wars Handbook 2: Crimson Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 2: ''Crimson Empire'']] {{C|under "The Imperial Interim Ruling Council"}}</ref> the mustachioed officer was placed in [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|supreme command]] of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] as an admiral<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> and in charge of Ord Cantrell's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] as a general.<ref name="Crimson Empire II 6" />

The mustachioed officer took [[Commander/Legends|command]] of a military that was thinly spread due to the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Hunting/Legends|manhunt]] for former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] [[Kir Kanos]]<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> called by council leader [[Xandel Carivus]],<ref name="Crimson Empire II 2">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 2|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 2]]</ref> and trouble raised by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] species<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> following the death of Whiphid councilor [[Ch'Unkk]].<ref name="Crimson Empire II 3">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 3|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 3]]</ref> When Carivus disbanded the Ruling Council and declared himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]],<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> he [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] his fellow councilors, including [[Feena D'Asta (clone)|Feena D'Asta]].<ref name="Crimson Empire II 6" /> [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]], the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of Feena and an Imperial-allied shipping magnate who commanded a large [[D'Asta private fleet|private fleet]], consequently threatened to withdraw his support from the Crimson Empire in a message sent to Ord Cantrell. The mustachioed officer received the message aboard his [[Unidentified flagship (Crimson Empire)|flagship]] and contacted Carivus on Ord Cantrell's surface, but the Emperor dismissed the [[Baron/Legends|Baron's]] threats as hollow and told the officer to deal with them himself.<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" />

===The Crimson falls===
Following his discussion with Carivus, the mustachioed officer received an urgent communiqué from the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] stating that he had captured Kir Kanos. The officer again contacted his Emperor and passed the information on. Not long afterward, Baron D'Asta's armada [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|attacked]] Ord Cantrell, and the mustachioed officer led the defense from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. The two fleets [[Space warfare/Legends|clashed]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and the scant Imperial forces left at Ord Cantrell were quickly overwhelmed by D'Asta's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]]. Carivus lambasted the officer via [[wallscreen]] during the battle, but the communication was terminated as the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] accumulated damage. The Imperial fleet was forced to retreat,<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /> and the mustachioed officer made his way to Carivus's Council Tower, which he was told to guard by the Emperor. Half of the Crimson Empire [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] had been involved in the orbital battle, and its remaining [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfought]] D'Asta's [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] within Ord Cantrell's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Within the tower, both Carivus and the mustachioed officer felt the damage to the building that was inflicted by D'Asta's fighters.<ref name="Crimson Empire II 6" />

Carivus had his [[Xandel Carivus's Private Guard|private guard]] retrieve the captive D'Asta, and he resolved to return her to her father in return for an end to hostilities. When the mustachioed officer pointed out that D'Asta still had the upper hand, he was shocked to hear a departing Carivus state that he would evacuate and abandon the [[Army/Legends|army]] forces stationed on-world if the Baron continued to press the attack. D'Asta, however, accepted Carivus's offer, and the mustachioed officer sought the Emperor out in his throne room to report as much. The Baron also sought a private audience with Carivus, and the Emperor dismissed the mustachioed officer in order to meet with D'Asta alone. The Baron turned out to be accompanied by Kir Kanos&mdash;freshly rescued from Grappa by New Republic forces&mdash;who killed Carivus as part of a vendetta he held against the entire Ruling Council.<ref name="Crimson Empire II 6" /> Following Carivus's death, centralized Imperial authority utterly collapsed, and the Galactic Empire ceased to exist.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|On page 126/7 of CEII, Carivus is talkign ''[sic]'' to a certain elderly walrus-handled admiral&hellip; Is this supposed to be our man Pellaeon?!''"<br />"''Do you want it to be him?|''[[Star Wars]]'' fan "Kuralyov" and Randy Stradley|<ref name="Cryptic Randy">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?t=9605|thread=CEII question for Randy|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2006-07-12|time=7:46 pm}}</ref>}}
The white-haired, mustachioed Imperial officer appeared in the final [[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|two]] [[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 6|issues]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'']].<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5" /><ref name="Crimson Empire II 6" /> His appearance closely resembles that of [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], another Imperial officer,<ref name="NEGTC Pellaeon">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|under "Gilad Pellaeon"}}</ref> but when ''Crimson Empire II'' author [[Randy Stradley]] was asked in [[2006]] if they were one and the same, he merely gave a cryptic answer.<ref name="Cryptic Randy" /> It was not until [[2009]] that the officer was revealed to be a unique character when ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' stated that Pellaeon was serving [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]], and not the Galactic Empire, during Carivus's reign as Emperor.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The character is called "Admiral" in ''Crimson Empire II''{{'s}} fifth issue, and both "Admiral" and "General" in its sixth. Similarly, the former issue sees Carivus state that the mustachioed officer is in charge of the Empire's fleets, while the latter has the officer reference his "troops." This article takes the discrepancy to mean that Carivus, in the midst of the Empire's death throes, appointed the officer as both an admiral in command of the Imperial Navy and a general in the Imperial Army.
